provenance.build: cargo build --release: opt-level = "z", lto = true, codegen-units = 1, strip = true

external.op: LOAD: graph (parse + column lineage + topo order)
external.note: Reads every .sql file, parses it (sqlparser), derives column-level lineage and prints the models in topological order. Plans nothing. single-threaded; Freshet keeps no parse cache, so every CLI run is cold and there is no separate warm CLI row. Compare with dbt parse / sqlmesh info, not with freshet plan.

external.op: PLAN0: plan vs no prior state (all N)
external.note: No state file, so every model is new: parse + lineage, AST-canonical fingerprint of every model, plan all N with reasons and a CU estimate, print it. Writes nothing (no --commit). single-threaded; Freshet keeps no parse cache, so every CLI run is cold and there is no separate warm CLI row.

external.op: DIFF: plan vs committed state, nothing changed (0)
external.note: Against the base project's snapshot (committed once by an untimed plan --commit): the same full parse + fingerprint as a cold run (the CLI has no cache), a state diff, and 'nothing to backfill'. A CLI re-plan, not the daemon's warm path (see the planner-serve row). single-threaded; Freshet keeps no parse cache, so every CLI run is cold and there is no separate warm CLI row.

external.op: DIFF: plan vs committed state, m_0_0 edited (k)
external.note: The edited project against the base project's committed snapshot: full parse + AST fingerprints, diff (only m_0_0 changed), then the column-aware downstream plan with reasons and a CU estimate. single-threaded; Freshet keeps no parse cache, so every CLI run is cold and there is no separate warm CLI row.

external.op: WARM: daemon replan, nothing changed (0)
external.note: A whole curl process against a running planner-serve that parsed the project once at start-up (untimed; the same load the freshet graph row times) and holds it in memory: loopback HTTP + the daemon's plan (AST-canonical re-fingerprint of all N models, which re-parses each one's SQL; diff against the committed in-memory snapshot) + the JSON reply. The CPU column covers the curl process only: the daemon is not its child, so the daemon's own work lands in this row's other-process CPU instead. A long-running daemon is a different architecture from the other tools' per-invocation caches; this is Freshet's warm path, not a like-for-like process.

external.op: LOAD: parse, cold (fresh checkout, no target/)
external.note: Full parse: renders every model's Jinja (the static parser handles these ref/source-only models), resolves refs, builds the DAG and writes target/manifest.json + partial_parse.msgpack. Plans nothing: dbt has no plan step, parse is what every dbt command starts with. Compare with freshet graph / sqlmesh info, not with a plan. single-threaded Python; includes interpreter start-up and adapter registration.
external.observed: dbt perf_info: load_all_elapsed 6.650 s (parse_project 4.968 s) over 1160 paths; static parser handled 1024 of 1024 models

external.op: WARM: parse, partial parse (default), nothing changed
external.note: target/partial_parse.msgpack from the previous run is present and no file changed, so dbt loads the pickled manifest instead of re-parsing (partial parsing is on by default). single-threaded Python; includes interpreter start-up and adapter registration.
external.observed: dbt perf_info: load_all_elapsed 0.691 s, partial parse enabled=True

external.op: LOAD: info --skip-connection, cold (no .cache/)
external.note: Loads the project: parses every model file (sqlglot), renders and optimizes each query with column types from external_models.yaml, builds the DAG, prints model/macro counts. --skip-connection: no warehouse or state access. Plans nothing. Compare with freshet graph / dbt parse. SQLMesh loads models in parallel worker processes (CPU time above wall time); analytics disabled in config.yaml and the environment.
external.observed: sqlmesh info: Models: 1025 Macros: 0 (the count includes the external model bench.src)

external.op: WARM: info --skip-connection, .cache/ present, nothing changed
external.note: As the cold row, with the .cache/ directory (parsed model definitions, optimized queries) left by the previous run. SQLMesh loads models in parallel worker processes (CPU time above wall time); analytics disabled in config.yaml and the environment.
external.observed: sqlmesh info: Models: 1025 Macros: 0 (the count includes the external model bench.src)

external.op: PLAN0: plan --explain vs an initialized empty state (all N)
external.note: Against a state initialized once (untimed) with nothing applied, so every model is added. Plan without execution: load (cold .cache, as in a fresh checkout), read the state, fingerprint every model's snapshot, categorize changes, compute missing intervals and print the explained plan. --explain applies nothing; each row reports whether the state file was byte-identical after its last repetition. SQLMesh loads models in parallel worker processes (CPU time above wall time); analytics disabled in config.yaml and the environment.
external.observed: 1024 models needing backfill; state file unchanged
